summary: Iteration scope review succeeded. The current iteration stories, elaborated requirements, and functional test design are consistent with the Left menu 4 intake and technically feasible within the existing Next.js dashboard shell. The planned story ids are preserved across planning, requirements, and test design. The intake typo `Provide Feedvack` is explicitly documented and normalized to `Provide Feedback`, matching the planned delivery story and test expectations. Existing source evidence confirms the dashboard currently uses a flat menu in `src/features/dashboard/shell.tsx`, protected dashboard layout in `src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx`, and existing pages for Home, Feedback Request, and Configure, so the requested two-level menu can be implemented without a prerequisite architecture change. Browser and Playwright verification were not run per task restriction; controller browser verification remains pending after implementation.
